# watchpoint_maintenance_window (Data Source)

Looks up a single maintenance window by name within the tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "watchpoint_maintenance_window" "example" {
  name = "Nightly Batch Window"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the maintenance window to look up (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `ends_at` (String) Window end (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `id` (String) Maintenance window ID.
- `starts_at` (String) Window start (RFC 3339, UTC).
